source.stem:
A ball is dropped from a table-top. Air resistance may be ignored.
Which row describes the velocity and the acceleration of the ball at point X?

mx.teacher_note: A magnet attracts an ordinary wooden block without contact.

mx.name: scope_error
mx.teacher_note: The force pulling a dropped stone toward Earth is magnetic force.

mx.name: surface_feature_capture
mx.teacher_note: The magnet attracts the shiny copper strip.

intelligence.enrichment: A magnet can exert a force on another magnet or on a magnetic material without being in contact with it; this force is called magnetic force. magnet near another magnet or magnetic material -> magnetic force without contact The learner correctly applies this rule: A magnet can exert a force on another magnet or on a magnetic material without being in contact with it; this force is called magnetic force. A magnet only works by touching objects, and any object near a magnet is magnetic.
